definitions.selection: Frozen manuscript cohort: 5 models x seeds4101-4105. Raw hashes checked; no new model calls.
definitions.fine: Actual pending charge recorded at RESULTS for the recipient, only after-result GIVE. Prep and no-fine transfers are separate.
definitions.crossing: recipient_before <= pending_fine < recipient_after. Strict > is required for positive balance after payment. An exact fine-sized balance reaches zero.
definitions.units: GIVE event counts are distinct from unique (session, round, recipient). Repeated crossings are retained as events, deduplicated for payment outcomes.
definitions.scope: Immediate accounting and subsequent recorded trajectory, not a counterfactual causal effect of giving or of shorter replies.
